senses.gloss: f. (נָטַר) guarding, esp. (with ref. to Lev. XIX, 18) bearing grudge. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. IV עד היכן כחה של נ׳ וכ׳ how far does the law forbidding to bear grudge extend? If you ask your neighbor for the loan of an axe, and he refuses, and the next day he asks thee …, say not, I am not like thee; Yoma 23ᵃ
